APPOINTMENTS BY THE GOVERNOR OF THE UVA PROVINCE

BY, virtue of the powers vested to me under Section 154 F. (1) and (5) of the 3rd Amendment to the Constitution of theDemocratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, I. M. P. Jayasinghe, Governor of Uva Province, do hereby announce that I havemade the following appointments of the Provincial Council of Uva Province with effect from 30th January, 2015.

01. Hon. Harin Fernando- Minister of Finance and Planning, Law and Peace, Education,Chief Minister of theLocal Government, Social Welfare, Rural InfrastructureUva Provincial CouncilDevelopment, Transport and Construction.
02. Hon. Anura Ravindra Vidanagamage- Minister of Agriculture, Irrigation, Inland Fisheries Industry,Member of the Uva ProvinceLand and Tourism AffairsProvincial Council
03. Hon. Jayasundara Mudiyanselage Ananda - Minister of Health, Indigenous Medicine, Probation and Childcare,
KumarasiriWomen's Affairs & Power and Energy.Member of the Uva ProvinceProvincial Council
04. Hon. Raveendra Samaraweera- Minister of Road Development, Housing, Water Supply,Member of the Uva ProvinceCo-operative, Animal Production and Cultural Affairs.Provincial Council
05. Hon. Vadivelu Suresh- Minister of Sports, Youth Affairs, Textiles and Small IndustriesMember of the Uva Province& Estate Infrastructure Development and Estate Education.Provincial Council
M. P. JAYASINGHE. Governor of Uva Province.Office of the Uva Governor,King's Street, Badulla.30th January, 2015
